description: Data representations for N-body state: particle attributes (mass, position, velocity, acceleration), system containers, and serialization
mathematical_formalization: State vector S = {(m_i, r_i, v_i, a_i) : i=1..N}; phase space point (q, p) in R^{4N}
implementation_hypothesis: Python dataclass for Body with numpy arrays; System class managing collection with add/remove/query and JSON serialization
experiment_seed: Benchmark serialization roundtrip time and memory footprint for N=10, 100, 1000
